what.text: This page follows internal displacement in France, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 2044 in 2019 to 105 in 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for France list floods, storms, wildfires and mass movements.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for France in these years.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2019.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 4452 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside France.
